plain_statement: Plane of order 3. If no point of X is on a line of Y, no three points of X are on a line and no three lines of Y pass through a point, then X lies in a point set Z, missed by every line of Y, that is a generic maximal false input (every outside point lies on a line missing Z; Z is in no line; no point lies on all lines missing Z).
title: A step toward: Order-3 plane: every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit true at incident pairs and false at all generic maximal false inputs has at least 64 gates
